videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants me to summarize a YouTube video transcript about Jeju Semiconductor stock outlook in Korean, within approximately 500 characters, using 3-5 sentences.
Key points from the transcript:
1. US stock market crashed, especially tech stocks (Nasdaq down 4%+)
2. Micron (memory semiconductor) dropped 13-14%, affecting memory sector
3. Interest rates surged (10-year treasury broke 4.5%, 30-year broke 5%) due to strong employment data (172k vs expected 80-90k)
4. This caused fears of delayed rate cuts and higher borrowing costs for AI infrastructure investments
5. Jeju Semiconductor likely to drop significantly on Monday along with Samsung/SK Hynix due to these factors
6. SpaceX IPO (largest ever) scheduled for next week on the 12th, causing some investors to sell AI stocks to raise funds for it
7. Market seeing this as a buying opportunity (undervalued territory)
I need to summarize this in Korean, 500 characters max, 3-5 sentences, no English.
